messages.content:
ある質問が、次の候補のうちどれについて尋ねているかを判定してください。

質問: Grafana のソースコード（テストを除く）において、SigV4 認証タイプが設定されている場合にその名前空間を安定して選択する役割を持つ、同じパッケージ内の特定の関数を直接呼び出している関数をすべて挙げよ。

候補:
A. externalIDKeys is the pair of jsonData keys holding a datasource's per-datasource external ID and the flag that turns it on. Both always come from the same namespace — native or SigV4-prefixed — so they travel as a unit.
B. buildGrafanaExternalID returns "{stackExternalId}-{dsUID}-{16 hex}". The hex suffix differs on every mint so delete→recreate with the same UID cannot reuse a prior IAM trust binding. It panics if the CSPRNG fails, since a guessable external ID would defeat the trust policy.
C. resolveOnUpdate decides which external ID an updated datasource ends up with. BeforeSave has already stripped whatever the payload carried, so the outcome is one of three: restore the stored ID, mint a fresh one, or leave the datasource on the stack ID.
D. mintOnCreate mints a fresh ID for a new Grafana Assume Role datasource. BeforeSave has already dropped any ID the payload carried, so a datasource that does not qualify simply ends up without one and falls back to the stack ID.
E. shouldMint reports whether an update with no restorable stored ID should get a fresh one.
F. externalIDKeysFor picks the namespace jsonData keeps its external ID in. A non-empty sigV4AuthType means SigV4: such a datasource signs with SigV4 for its whole life, so the namespace stays stable even when it leaves Grafana Assume Role (e.g. sigV4AuthType becomes "keys"). A present-but-empty value 
G. isValidGrafanaExternalID reports whether id is bound to this stack + datasource UID with a 16-char lowercase hex suffix.
H. BeforeSave mints or preserves the per-datasource grafanaExternalId of a Grafana Assume Role datasource. Pass existing=nil on create; pass the stored JsonData on update.

- 質問の内容に最も合う候補の記号を choice に書く。
- 二つ以上の候補が同じくらい当てはまり、質問だけではどれか決められないときは ambiguous を true にする。
- reason に判断の理由を短く書く。
JSON で答えてください。

content: {"choice": "F", "ambiguous": false, "reason": "質問にある「SigV4 認証タイプが設定されている場合にその名前空間を安定して選択する役割を持つ関数」という記述が、候補Fの「externalIDKeysFor picks the namespace... A non-empty sigV4AuthType means SigV4... the namespace stays stable」という説明と完全に一致するため。"}
